messages:
Sam (CS): Quick recap from AcuityPay onboarding call — they raised a few feature asks and a renewal concern, pinging @Liz and @Mike.
Anna (Onboarding): Dropping raw bullet notes from the demo.
Sam (CS): Main points:
• Per-route cost breakdown is missing when they use a hybrid model routing setup — finance won't approve the pilot without it.
• No sample prompts for payments/invoice connectors — slows POC, leads to extra CS time.
• During a concurrency spike they observed ~12% 500 errors; customer engineering said "If we see those 500s in prod we will halt rollout and reconsider renewal."
• Ask summary: default graceful fallback to smaller model + Console visibility for per-route billing + onboarding prompt packs.
Mike (CSE): Can we reproduce the 500s on our side? If renewal risk is real we should escalate to P0.
Sam (CS): They hit the errors only during the demo spike (concurrency >80). Quote from AcuityPay lead eng: "When model errors happen during peak traffic we see 500s, can't explain costs, and we won't commit until there's graceful fallback and clear per-route cost." Will upload recording to the ticket.
Liz (Product): Proposed triage: fallback behavior = P0 (safety/regression), per-route billing visibility = P1 (enterprise), prompt packs = P2 (enablement). Agree?
Anna (Onboarding): I can assemble starter prompts for payments/invoices and a copy-to-console snippet as a temporary workaround. Can do EOD Tue.
Mike (CSE): We have an internal runtime flag `model_fallback_policy` on Dedicated. Short plan:
1) Expose a Console toggle for fallback policy (experimental).
2) Wire toggle to routing layer to route overloads to compact model variant.
3) Emit telemetry for fallback events so we can validate.
Quick add to tracker via CLI:
```/feedback add AcuityPay "fallback toggle + per-route visibility" priority:P0 account:AcuityPay```
Liz (Product): If Mike can prototype, we can ship as an experimental Console feature in ~2 weeks. Mike — include cost/latency delta for fallback in the ticket. Anna — prompt pack by Tue. Sam — paste verbatim quote and attach demo.
Mike (CSE): Preliminary metrics: compact fallback reduces GPU compute ~35% (lower cost) but adds ~60–150ms latency depending on seq length. I'll attach measured samples to PROD-4521.
ProductBot: New ticket created: PROD-4521 — "AcuityPay: fallback toggle + per-route visibility" assigned to Liz (Product), Mike (CSE). https://redwood.atlassian/PROD-4521
Sam (CS): I'll paste transcript and attach recording to the ticket now. Handoff once PRD + ticket updates are done.
Anna (Onboarding): Uploading prompt pack + copy snippet when ready.
Liz (Product): I'll draft PRD with acceptance criteria and rollout steps. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
